svg.text: SQL · S07 · A view is a contract — not a free performance button
Tables → view → DTO. The plan is still the SELECT.
Indexed views persist work. Ordinary views do not.
Joins stay in the view. API and Angular see one shape.
A view is not faster until the plan says so.

text.tspan: SELECT * FROM vw JOIN bases again
Indexed view only for a hot aggregate
Do not re-join the same tables

svg.text: vwDeviceList so the API does not copy five joins.
SELECT d.Id, d.Name, c.Name AS Customer
Stable shape, not a free index.
A DTO projection is the C# cousin of a view contract.
SELECT d.Id, d.Name, c.Name AS Customer ...
JOIN dbo.Device d ON d.Id = v.Id

text.tspan: Call the view a contract for a screen
Prove speed with a plan, not the word view
Indexed view only when the aggregate is constant
Re-join the view to the same bases
